# Startup Desktop Fixture

`stellar-desktop.webp` is a 1440px-wide derivative of the project's existing
`Wallpaper/public/assets/fallback.jpg`, encoded with FFmpeg WebP quality 84.
It is a static desktop backdrop for contrast checks, not a captured personal
desktop or an additional production theme asset.

`Orbitron-Variable.ttf` and its unmodified `Orbitron-OFL.txt` license are copied
from `Release050/public/fonts/`. The startup fixture uses the same local
Orbitron 400 face as the v0.5.0 closing product name, only for its window caption.
It does not change the message font or add a production font dependency.
